title: Jeb_ Cushion
description: Renaming a Cushion to Jeb_ makes it rainbow like a sheep
body:
This datapack makes the cushions added in 26.3 Snapshot 3 cycle through all colors if named jeb_, similarly to sheep

![jeb_ cushions next to a jeb_ sheep animated](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/afZUHBrL/images/0114059ef7609ab2dd07df7a24244bd3b83d6cd7.gif)

when broken it also drops its original color cushion, making it completely survival friendly
